dialoguesToLoad.text: Ok, this city is pretty sick. It's enormous! They built it on top of this weird castle... Occidens looks shabby next to this.
Well, we do spend a lot of resources on maintaining it in pristine condition.
it's a bit weird though... They're so adamant on not using Old world tech and yet they have an elevator...
What's an elevator? Oh, you mean the Riser? Yes, it is an old device created by the mighty engineer Olphus using the Hero's drafts.
Sooo, THIS is fine for you guys?
Of course, this is Archades engineering. It has nothing to do with the devilish Old World devices.
You have no clue how any of this works, do you? This is exactly the same.
Why are you so surprised, pupil? I might start thinking that you're all really from Occidens, you know.
Now, if that were the case why would we be here?
The king might be in danger! Let's go!
